criteria.evidence: Pipeline diagram 'Query → Retrieval → Context assembly → Prompt → LLM → Answer' with distinct failure points (1) retrieval, (2) context assembly/ordering, (3) prompt/grounding instructions, (4) generation ignoring context—explicitly tracing boundaries.
criteria.criterion: Trace retrieval, context construction, and generation boundaries.

criteria.evidence: Repeatedly instructs to log/read chunks, verify recall via logging before reranking, and 'What I'd avoid adding right away' section says add fixes 'only after logs show precision/ordering is genuinely the gap — not as a first guess.'

Verification section proposes a held-out Q&A set with known correct source passages to measure Recall@k and grounding rate in isolation from other changes, and gating reranker addition on confirmed isolated diagnosis ('only if you've confirmed via logging that recall is fine and precision/ordering is the actual gap').
criteria.criterion: Use an isolation experiment where appropriate.
